about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Vince Fong

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO CALIFORNIA STATE NONROAD ENGINE POLLUTION CONTROL S
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO CALIFORNIA STATE NONROAD ENGINE POLLUTION CONTROL STANDARDS; OCEAN-GOING VESSELS AT...
sentences: Vessels are required to use State-approved emissions control technology, yet those technologies are not always commercially available or even feasible.

Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of H.J. Res. 210, my Congressional Review Act resolution because California should not be able to impose costly shipping mandates that drive up prices across the Nation, disrupt our supply chain, and put our energy security at risk.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.J. Res. 210.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
statements.title: NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2027
sentences: Mr. Chair, I rise today in support of my amendments to the fiscal year 2027 National Defense Authorization Act.
I urge my colleagues to support them.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DOUG LAMALFA FEDERAL DISASTER TAX RELIEF CERTAINTY ACT
statements.title: DOUG LAMALFA FEDERAL DISASTER TAX RELIEF CERTAINTY ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the Doug LaMalfa Federal Disaster Tax Relief Certainty Act, which includes my bill, the Doug LaMalfa Protect Innocent Victims of Taxation after Fire Extension Act, which was his bill that he originally fought for.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CLERGY ACT
statements.title: CLERGY ACT
sentences: This bipartisan legislation, cosponsored by my fellow California Congressman Mike Thompson, would create a one-time re- enrollment window for pastors and other clergy members who have previously opted out of Social Security, many in their youth, to voluntarily opt back in.
For decades, members of the clergy have made the permanent decision of opting out of Social Security.
As lawmakers, we have a fundamental responsibility to strengthen Social Security in its current form while providing a pillar of protection for our seniors, including our faith leaders.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my bill H.R. 227, the Clergy Act.
I urge support for this bill and hope to ensure those who have given so much are not left behind in retirement.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR TAX POLICIES THAT SUPPORT WORKING FAMILIES
statements.title: EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR TAX POLICIES THAT SUPPORT WORKING FAMILIES
sentences: On July 4, 2025, we delivered the largest working families tax cut in American history.

The result is no tax on tips, no tax on overtime, the child tax credit boosted to $2,200 per child and made permanent, taxes on Social Security slashed, and a $1,000 Trump tax account for every newborn American.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPRESSING THE SUPPORT OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY
statements.title: EXPRESSING THE SUPPORT OF THE HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES FOR THE DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H. Res. 1128, Expressing the Support of the House of Representatives for the Department of Homeland Security.
I urge my colleagues across the aisle to come to their senses, immediately reopen the Department of Homeland Security, and end the shutdown immediately.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REAUTHORIZATION OF INTEGRATED COASTAL AND OCEAN OBSERVATION SYSTEM ACT OF 2009
statements.title: REAUTHORIZATION OF INTEGRATED COASTAL AND OCEAN OBSERVATION SYSTEM ACT OF 2009
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my bill, the Save Our Sequoias Act.

I introduced this legislation with my California colleague Representative Scott Peters to safeguard our remaining giant Sequoia groves, the most in my district, by cutting red tape and restoring resilience to our forests.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 7744, FURTHER ADDITIONAL CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 7744, FURTHER ADDITIONAL CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2026
sentences: Today, we face growing threats as our Nation encounters the real danger posed by the Iranian regime, as well as other adversaries around the world.
I urge my colleagues across the aisle to join us in voting to reopen the Department of Homeland Security so it can get back to its core mission of safeguarding American communities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
statements.title: SUPPORTING PREGNANT AND PARENTING WOMEN AND FAMILIES ACT
sentences: The Temporary Assistance for Needy Families program was created to strengthen families, reduce dependency, and ensure children can be cared for in their own homes.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 6945, the Supporting Pregnant and Parenting Women and Families Act.
Mr. Speaker, this bill stands for mothers, children, and families, and I urge my colleagues to support it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE HONORABLE DOUG LaMALFA
statements.title: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE HONORABLE DOUG LaMALFA
sentences: I certainly will vow to honor Doug's memory by continuing to champion the values that we both share that unite California's Central Valley to the rural communities like Doug's in northern California.
I will continue fighting for rural priorities in Congress just as Doug did.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESEARCHING EFFICIENT FEDERAL IMPROVEMENTS FOR NECESSARY ENERGY REFINING ACT
statements.title: RESEARCHING EFFICIENT FEDERAL IMPROVEMENTS FOR NECESSARY ENERGY REFINING ACT
sentences: They convert crude oil into fuels and countless products, ranging from shoes and plastics to cell phones, computers, solar panels, medical devices, and even space suits.
They make gasoline and diesel for our cars and trucks, and they make jet fuel for our planes.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 3109, the REFINER Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ACCELERATING NETWORKING, CYBERINFRASTRUCTURE, AND HARDWARE FOR OCEANIC RESEARCH ACT
statements.title: ACCELERATING NETWORKING, CYBERINFRASTRUCTURE, AND HARDWARE FOR OCEANIC RESEARCH ACT
sentences: Data is the heartbeat of scientific progress.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of my bill, H.R. 1223, the Accelerating Networking, Cyberinfrastructure, and Hardware for Oceanic Research Act, also known as the ANCHOR Act.

I urge my colleagues to support this bill because it addresses a critical and urgent need: safeguarding the integrity of our Nation's academic research fleet and ensuring that the valuable data collected at sea remains secure from emerging threats.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SPACE DOMINANCE
statements.title: SPACE DOMINANCE
sentences: We are known for our innovation and research and continuing to push the boundaries of space exploration and our rich legacy in this industry.

As we see our foreign adversaries like Russia, China, and Iran increasing their space technology efforts, it is critical that we stay ahead of the curve to ensure we stay at the cutting edge of technologies.
This is one of the reasons why I introduced the Making Advancement in Commercial Hypersonics Act, also known as the MACH Act.
The Advanced Capabilities for Emergency Response Operations Act, also known as the ACERO Act, which I introduced earlier this year, authorizes NASA to leverage the use of drones to fight wildfires.
Our work is just getting started in space as a Nation, and here in Congress we are committed to seeing strides of advancement to make our Nation dominant in new and advancing technology.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HALT ALL LETHAL TRAFFICKING OF FENTANYL ACT
statements.title: HALT ALL LETHAL TRAFFICKING OF FENTANYL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 27, the HALT Fentanyl Act.
It will ensure that these deadly substances are classified permanently so law enforcement has the ability to seize these lethal drugs.
Law enforcement is on the front lines, fighting this crisis every single day, as drugs flow across the southern border.
We cannot allow drug traffickers to push deadlier mixtures that are poisoning our youth.

It is our job in this Chamber to ensure that they have the tools they need to stay ahead of drug traffickers, Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to protect our communities by voting ``yes'' on H.R. 27.
